Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p6); balances are fund balances 4,984,037 / 4,070,359 (p6); roll-forward 4,984,037 + 5,304,571 - 6,493,249 + transfers in (net) 275,000 = 4,070,359 (General Fund in 315,000, Sales Tax Fund out 40,000; enterprise funds out 275,000, p10). Bond/loan proceeds 2,370,000 and bond premium 21,297 are printed among revenues (inside Total revenues), so they are receipt lines (Debt Proceeds / Bond Premium), not debt_proceeds. Ending cash from the governmental funds balance sheet Total column (p5): cash and cash equivalents 3,793,284 + county treasurer cash 156,895; certificates of deposit 115,143 in ending_investments; no prior-year cash printed, so beginning_cash null. Business-type from the enterprise funds Total column (pp9-10): 8,841,359 + 5,095,203 - 4,291,275 - 275,000 = 9,370,287; Internal Service Fund column (health insurance, governmental activities) excluded. Business-type receipts total computed (operating + nonoperating revenues); disbursements total 4,291,275 = SoA total business-type expenses (p2) = operating 4,287,463 + interest expense 3,812. Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position (p1), Governmental/Business-type columns, component units excluded. Grant income / grant revenue: grantor not printed, category other (detail Grants). Street Fund Intergovernmental: highway allocation not printed, other state aid. 'Transportation' expense lines: context label, object not stated. Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp22-23, department columns; more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule pp15-16, which is not recorded); Street, Sales Tax, Debt Service and Capital Projects budget schedules (pp17-20; Capital Projects prints no revenue total); nonmajor CDBG and Cemetery Perpetual Care funds from the combining statement (p21); proprietary funds by fund column (pp9-10; nonoperating items and transfers outside the printed operating totals). General Fund departmental interest income row is off by 1 (report rounding): report_discrepancies. Read pages 1-23 of 23
